name: EURO PANEL PRODUCTS LTD
summary: Euro Panel Products Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of aluminum composite panels in India and Europe. It also provides aluminum HPL, zinc composite panels, fire retardant panels, and aluminum honeycomb and composite panels. The company sells its products under the Eurobond brand, as well as exports its products. It operates through a network of dealers and distributors. The company serves customers in pharma/hospitals, automobile, corporate signage, transport, metro and railways, petroleum, government, construction, and banking sectors. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
